At the top of the frame, hand-written style yellow text appears along with a small rectangular inset video showing a woman in a music video. (2) The man begins playing the piano with both hands, his fingers moving fluidly across the white and black keys. He leans toward a black condenser microphone on a stand to sing. His facial expression is focused and emotive, with slight movements of his mouth and eyes as he performs. The inset video updates to show different scenes from Stephanie Sun's music videos. Yellow and white captions appear at the bottom center of the screen. (3) Throughout the medley, the man maintains his seated position, occasionally glancing down at the keys and then back up at the camera. He wears a single white wired earbud in his right ear. The environment remains static, focusing entirely on the musical performance. Various song titles and credits appear in the top right corner as he transitions between five different tracks. (4) The video concludes with the man finishing his final song, looking directly into the lens with a slight smile of satisfaction. He lifts both hands from the piano keys and gives a double thumbs-up gesture toward the camera. The lighting remains constant and bright until the frame fades to black.
